name: International Protection (Asylum) -- Structural Absence

qualifying_event.description: Vietnam is not a party to the 1951 Refugee Convention or its 1967 Protocol, has no domestic refugee or asylum legislation, and has no national refugee status determination procedure. UNHCR reported (as of its 2019 submission, the most recent found) that no asylum applications had been received by Vietnamese authorities since 2002. There is no working, generally-available route to protection status inside Vietnam's own legal system.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Not applicable -- no domestic application process exists.

requirements.blocker_text: Vietnam has not established a refugee status determination procedure and its domestic legal framework does not include refugee or asylum legislation.

outcome.duration_length: not applicable -- no domestic status exists to grant

sources.title: UNHCR submission to Vietnam's Universal Periodic Review (2019) -- confirms Vietnam is not a signatory to the 1951 Convention or 1967 Protocol, has no refugee/asylum legislation or status determination procedure, and had received no asylum applications since 2002; UNHCR's role is limited to technical assistance/capacity-building recommendations rather than operational refugee processing

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Vietnam). This file documents a genuine STRUCTURAL ABSENCE, consistent with this dataset's convention (see Oman's international_protection.json for the precedent) of disclosing rather than fabricating a route where none exists. The source is UNHCR's own 2019 UPR submission (tier-2, intergovernmental) -- the most specific and authoritative document found in this pass, but now 6+ years old; no more recent confirmation or contradiction was independently checked, so this should be treated as the best available evidence of a durable structural fact (Vietnam's non-accession to the Convention) rather than a fully current process snapshot. Unlike Oman (which at least has a discretionary political-refugee-by-Royal-Decree mechanism), no equivalent discretionary humanitarian mechanism was found for Vietnam in this pass -- if one exists, it was not identified.
